en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a town square with cobblestone streets. A large, multi‑story building labeled "Hôtel zur grünen Tanne" dominates the right side, with horse‑drawn carriage, pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing, and surrounding historic townhouses. In the background a tall church tower rises above the roofs. At the top in red script it reads "Zwickau. Regierungsplatz und Schulstraße." indicating the depicted square and street.
